items.expected: Use the digitization envelopes as reading bounds, not calibrated experimental standard deviations. Track concentration, power versus intensity, time units and path length. Do not substitute Z-scan beam calibration for SSPM without evidence. A model fit must be linked to the data, code, fitted parameter definition and evidence about parameter uncertainty or identifiability.

Analyze the actual time/intensity markers quantitatively under their stated conditions. Report empirical behavior and/or inferred parameters with definitions, raw residual/prediction evidence and a defensible treatment of reading versus experimental uncertainty.

items.statement: Evidence that distinguishes the claimed explanation
items.expected: Establish what response explanation is supported by a self-chosen model and tests. Show why alternative parameterizations or unresolved calibration do or do not change the claimed inference; no fixed three-model competition or split is mandatory.
Distinguish parameter precision conditional on a model from physical identifiability. Treat missing exposure/beam information explicitly and assess its effect on any extrapolation.
